extra_vocab.en: a short word for technology, or a person who fixes computers and machines
extra_vocab.note: tech 是 technology 或 technician 的口語縮寫。多益常見於 tech support（技術支援）、tech company（科技公司）；指人時是負責維修設備的技術人員。正式文件多寫完整的 technology 或 technician。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tech 是口語縮寫；正式的信件或報告中，建議寫 technology（科技）或 technician（技術人員）。

example.en: The company employs ten techs to repair customer computers.
example.zh: 這家公司僱用十位技術人員來修理客戶的電腦。

example.en: You can reach tech support by phone or by email.
example.zh: 你可以用電話或電子郵件聯絡技術支援。

example.en: The tech company launched a new app last month.
example.zh: 這家科技公司上個月推出了一款新的應用程式。

example.en: Our tech team fixed the website problem in an hour.
example.zh: 我們的技術團隊在一小時內解決了網站的問題。

examples.en: Our tech will visit your office this afternoon to check the server.
examples.zh: 我們的技術人員今天下午會到你的辦公室檢查伺服器。

examples.en: The tech industry has grown quickly over the past decade.
examples.zh: 科技業在過去十年成長得很快。

examples.en: He applied for a job as a lab tech at the hospital.
examples.zh: 他應徵了這家醫院的實驗室技術員工作。

confusable.diff: technique 指做事的方法或技巧，不是指科技或技術人員。

example.en: She teaches a new sales technique to the staff.
example.zh: 她向員工教授一種新的銷售技巧。

example.en: This device saves energy and costs very little.
example.zh: 這個裝置節省能源，而且很便宜。

example.en: We need to update the software before Monday.
example.zh: 我們需要在星期一前更新軟體。

derived.link: tech + -nology（學問、技術的整體），像 biology、psychology，指整體的科技
tech + -ician，做專業工作的人，像 musician、electrician

example.en: The tech replaced the broken screen in ten minutes.
example.zh: 技術人員在十分鐘內換好了壞掉的螢幕。

example.en: Tech stocks rose sharply on Monday after the earnings report.
example.zh: 財報公布後，科技股在星期一大幅上漲。

senses.en: technology, or the business of making technology products

example.en: She works in tech and travels often for business.
example.zh: 她在科技業工作，常常出差。

senses.en: a person whose job is to fix or check equipment
senses.distinguish: 前面有 a/the 或後面接 will visit、fix 這類動作時，通常指人；單獨出現且不可數時，多半指科技業。

example.en: Call the tech if the network goes down again.
example.zh: 如果網路又斷線，就打電話給技術人員。

extra_vocab.en: the rate at which workers leave a company, or the total money a business earns
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的是 staff turnover（員工離職率）；在英式英語財報中也指營業額，美式多用 revenue 或 sales。要靠上下文判斷是人員流動、金額，還是存貨週轉。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: turnover 當「離職率、營業額」時是不可數名詞，常搭配 high、low 來形容：a high turnover，也可說 high turnover rate。

example.en: Several branches reported strong turnovers during the holiday season.
example.zh: 好幾間分店在假期期間回報了很高的週轉率。

example.en: The manager wants to reduce staff turnover this year.
example.zh: 經理希望今年降低員工流動率。

example.en: Their annual turnover is about five million dollars.
example.zh: 他們的年營業額大約是五百萬美元。

example.en: A high turnover rate can raise training costs.
example.zh: 高離職率可能會增加訓練成本。

example.en: Better inventory turnover helps the store save space and money.
example.zh: 更好的存貨週轉率能幫商店節省空間與金錢。

examples.en: Turnover is high because many workers leave within a year.
examples.zh: 離職率很高，因為許多員工在一年內就離開。

examples.en: The shop's turnover reached two million dollars last year.
examples.zh: 這家店去年的營業額達到兩百萬美元。

examples.en: Fast turnover means goods do not stay long in the store.
examples.zh: 週轉快代表商品不會在店裡放太久。

confusable.diff: turn over 是兩個字的動詞片語，意思是翻面或移交；turnover 是名詞。
confusable.usage: turnover 是名詞，連在一起寫；turn over 是動詞片語，如 turn over the page（翻頁）。

example.en: Please turn over the page and read the next section.
example.zh: 請翻到下一頁，閱讀下一個部分。

similar.diff: revenue 指公司的收入總額，美式財報最常用；turnover 在英式用法中也可指營業額，另外還能指離職率。

example.en: Revenue grew by ten percent in the third quarter.
example.zh: 第三季的營收成長了百分之十。

example.en: The company made a small profit last year.
example.zh: 這家公司去年賺了一小筆利潤。

example.en: Sales rose quickly after we lowered the price last month.
example.zh: 我們降價之後，銷售額上升了。

example.en: The staff meeting starts at nine tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 員工會議明天早上九點開始。

senses.en: the number of workers who leave and are replaced

example.en: New benefits may lower employee turnover in our call center.
example.zh: 新的福利可能會降低我們客服中心的員工流動。

senses.en: the total amount of money a business earns
senses.distinguish: 句中出現金額、年度、銷售等字時，多半是營業額。

example.en: The café's monthly turnover doubled after the new menu launched.
example.zh: 新菜單推出後，這家咖啡店的月營業額成長了一倍。

senses.en: how fast goods are sold and replaced in a store
senses.distinguish: 和商品、存貨、庫存一起出現時，指貨賣得多快。

example.en: Milk has a quick turnover because customers buy it every day.
example.zh: 牛奶的週轉很快，因為顧客每天都會買。

extra_vocab.en: to pull a car or boat behind another vehicle
extra_vocab.note: tow 指用車輛把另一輛車或船拖走，多益常見於停車場告示、道路救援與違規停車的情境，如 Your car will be towed。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tow 後面直接接被拖的車；常搭配 away 或 to：tow a car to the garage。被動寫成 be towed (away)。

example.en: This company tows illegally parked cars every morning.
example.zh: 這家公司每天早上都會拖吊違規停放的車輛。

example.en: The truck towed the damaged van to the repair shop.
example.zh: 那輛卡車把受損的廂型車拖到了修理廠。

example.en: The driver is towing a small boat to the lake.
example.zh: 司機正拖著一艘小船前往湖邊。

example.en: A tow truck arrived at the parking lot within twenty minutes.
example.zh: 拖吊車在二十分鐘內就到了。

example.en: Security may tow away any car blocking the exit.
example.zh: 警衛可能會拖走任何擋住出口的車。

example.en: Do not park in the tow-away zone near the entrance.
example.zh: 請不要停在入口附近的拖吊區。

example.en: The towing service charges fifty dollars per trip.
example.zh: 這項拖吊服務每趟收費五十美元。

examples.en: We can tow your car to the nearest repair shop.
examples.zh: 我們可以把你的車拖到最近的修理廠。

examples.en: Large trucks are needed to tow broken buses off the road.
examples.zh: 需要大型卡車才能把壞掉的巴士拖離道路。

examples.en: Our service offers a free tow within ten kilometers.
examples.zh: 我們的服務提供十公里內免費拖吊。

confusable.diff: toe 是腳趾，發音和 tow 完全相同，但意思無關。

example.en: She hurt her toe when a box fell at work.
example.zh: 她在工作時被掉下來的箱子砸到腳趾。

similar.diff: pull 是一般的拉；tow 專指用車輛拖著另一輛車或船。

example.en: Please pull the cart to the back of the store.
example.zh: 請把推車拉到店的後方。

example.en: Pull the door gently because it is very old.
example.zh: 請輕輕拉門，因為它很舊了。

example.en: Trucks haul goods from the port to the factory.
example.zh: 卡車把貨物從港口運到工廠。

example.en: This truck can tow up to three tons.
example.zh: 這輛卡車最多可以拖三噸重。

example.en: The driver gave us a tow to the nearest garage.
example.zh: 司機把我們拖到了最近的修車廠。

extra_vocab.en: a person or a device that changes words from one language into another
extra_vocab.note: translator 多指做文件、合約、說明書的筆譯人員，在會議、客戶接待與求才廣告中很常見；也可以指翻譯軟體或翻譯機。

example.en: Our translators finished the user manual in three days.
example.zh: 我們的翻譯人員在三天內完成了使用手冊。

example.en: We decided to hire a translator for the new contract.
example.zh: 我們決定為新合約僱用一位翻譯人員。

example.en: A professional translator checked every page of the report.
example.zh: 一位專業翻譯人員檢查了報告的每一頁。

example.en: The tourist used a translator app to order lunch.
example.zh: 這位遊客用翻譯應用程式點了午餐。

examples.en: We need a translator for the meeting with our Japanese clients.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位翻譯，來協助和日本客戶的會議。

examples.en: The agency is looking for a translator who knows Spanish.
examples.zh: 這間公司正在找懂西班牙文的翻譯人員。

examples.en: This translator works offline, so it is useful on trips.
examples.zh: 這台翻譯機可以離線使用，所以出差時很方便。

confusable.diff: interpreter 是口譯，在現場用說的；translator 是筆譯，處理文字資料。

example.en: The interpreter spoke softly beside the manager during the talk.
example.zh: 會談時，口譯人員在經理旁邊輕聲翻譯。

example.en: The editor checked the translation before printing it.
example.zh: 編輯在印刷前檢查了這份譯文。

example.en: The writer sent us the final draft today.
example.zh: 作者今天寄給我們最終稿。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞，意思是把一種語言換成另一種語言
translate + -ion，把動作變成名詞，像 reservation、education

senses.en: a person whose job is to change written words into another language

example.en: The translator sent the finished contract back to us on Friday.
example.zh: 翻譯人員在星期五把完成的合約寄回給我們。

senses.en: a machine or program that changes words into another language
senses.distinguish: 句中有 app、device、works offline 等字時，指機器或軟體。

example.en: The pocket translator supports more than forty languages.
example.zh: 這台口袋翻譯機支援超過四十種語言。

extra_vocab.en: the money you pay to attend a school or a course
extra_vocab.note: tuition 指學校或課程的學費，多益常見於公司補助進修（tuition reimbursement）、學校公告與教育貸款的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: tuition 是不可數名詞，不加 s，前面也不加 a；說「一筆學費」要用 tuition fee。

example.en: The tuition fee includes books and exam costs.
example.zh: 學費包含書籍和考試費用。

example.en: Many students pay tuition in two installments each school year.
example.zh: 許多學生分兩期繳交學費。

example.en: Tuition reimbursement is offered to all full-time employees.
example.zh: 所有全職員工都可以申請學費補助。

examples.en: Tuition for the spring term is due by January 15.
examples.zh: 春季學期的學費須在一月十五日前繳清。

examples.en: Our company will pay your tuition if you pass the course.
examples.zh: 如果你通過這門課，公司會幫你付學費。

examples.en: She works part-time to cover her tuition and living costs.
examples.zh: 她打工來支付學費和生活費。

confusable.diff: tutor 是家教或輔導老師（人）；tuition 是學費（錢）。

example.en: The tutor helps students prepare for the TOEIC test.
example.zh: 這位家教老師幫助學生準備多益考試。

similar.diff: fee 是各種費用的統稱；tuition 專指上課的學費。

example.en: A small fee is charged for late registration.
example.zh: 太晚報名要收取一小筆費用。

example.en: She won a scholarship to study business abroad.
example.zh: 她獲得了出國讀商學的獎學金。

example.en: He took a loan to pay for school.
example.zh: 他貸款來支付學費。

senses.en: money paid for classes at a school or college

example.en: The college will raise tuition by three percent next year.
example.zh: 這所大學明年會調漲百分之三的學費。

senses.en: teaching given to a person or a small group
senses.distinguish: 常見於 private tuition（私人授課）；前面有 private、extra 等字時，指教學而不是學費。

example.en: He offers private tuition in business English on weekends.
example.zh: 他在週末提供商用英文的私人授課。

extra_vocab.en: a flat computer you use by touching the screen, or a small round medicine
extra_vocab.note: tablet 在多益最常見是「平板電腦」，出現在辦公、銷售與產品介紹；在醫療或藥局情境則是「藥片」，看上下文判斷。

example.en: We ordered fifty tablets for the new training program.
example.zh: 我們為新的訓練計畫訂購了五十台平板電腦。

example.en: Each sales rep received a tablet computer for customer visits.
example.zh: 每位業務代表都拿到一台平板電腦，用來拜訪客戶。

example.en: The tablet screen is easy to read outdoors.
example.zh: 這台平板的螢幕在戶外也很容易閱讀。

example.en: Please buy a tablet case to protect your device.
example.zh: 請買一個平板保護套來保護你的裝置。

examples.en: Staff can use a tablet to check orders in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 員工可以用平板電腦在倉庫查看訂單。

examples.en: Take one tablet after each meal with a glass of water.
examples.zh: 每餐飯後配一杯水服用一片藥。

examples.en: The new tablet is lighter and cheaper than last year's model.
examples.zh: 這款新平板比去年的型號更輕也更便宜。

confusable.diff: table 是桌子或表格；tablet 多了字尾 -let，指平板或藥片。

example.en: The report is on the table in the meeting room.
example.zh: 報告放在會議室的桌上。

similar.diff: pill 是藥丸，口語常用；tablet 是壓製成片的藥，語氣較正式。

example.en: The doctor told him to take one pill daily.
example.zh: 醫師要他每天吃一顆藥。

example.en: I bring my laptop to every client meeting.
example.zh: 我每次和客戶開會都會帶筆電。

example.en: Most of our customers book hotel rooms with their smartphones.
example.zh: 大部分客人用智慧型手機訂房。

senses.en: a small flat computer with a touch screen

example.en: The waiter takes our orders on a tablet.
example.zh: 服務生用平板電腦記錄我們的餐點。

senses.en: a small, hard piece of medicine that you swallow
senses.distinguish: 和 doctor、pharmacy、take、daily 一起出現時，指藥片。

example.en: The pharmacy sells vitamin tablets at a discount this week.
example.zh: 這間藥局本週的維他命藥片有折扣。

extra_vocab.en: a unit used to measure the weight of very heavy things like cargo
extra_vocab.note: ton 是重量單位「噸」，多益常見於貨運、倉儲與環保的數字描述；口語的 a ton of／tons of 則表示「很多」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示數量時 ton 用複數：five tons of steel；但放在名詞前當形容詞時不加 s：a five-ton truck。

example.en: Trucks delivered twenty tons of rice to the port.
example.zh: 卡車把二十噸的米運到了港口。

example.en: The factory produces two metric tons of steel daily.
example.zh: 這間工廠每天生產兩公噸的鋼鐵。

example.en: The price of this steel is eighty dollars per ton.
example.zh: 價格是每噸八十美元。

example.en: We have tons of orders to process this week.
example.zh: 我們這週有一大堆訂單要處理。

examples.en: The ship can carry up to fifty thousand tons of cargo.
examples.zh: 這艘船最多可以載運五萬噸的貨物。

examples.en: The plant reduced its waste by ten tons last year.
examples.zh: 這間工廠去年減少了十噸廢棄物。

examples.en: I have a ton of emails to answer before noon.
examples.zh: 我中午前有一大堆電子郵件要回。

confusable.diff: tone 是語氣或音調，多了字尾 e，發音也不同。

example.en: She used a polite tone in her email.
example.zh: 她在電子郵件中使用了有禮貌的語氣。

confusable.diff: tonne 是英式拼法的公噸，發音和 ton 相同。

example.en: The report lists emissions in tonnes, not pounds.
example.zh: 這份報告用公噸而不是磅來列出排放量。

example.en: The shipping box weighs about ten kilograms in total.
example.zh: 這個箱子大約重十公斤。

example.en: The package for our new client weighs five pounds in total.
example.zh: 這個包裹總共重五磅。

example.en: Please check the weight limit before shipping the package abroad.
example.zh: 寄送前請先確認重量限制。

senses.en: a unit of weight for very heavy things

example.en: The bridge can hold trucks of up to thirty tons.
example.zh: 這座橋可以承載最重三十噸的卡車。

senses.en: a very large amount of something
senses.distinguish: 常寫成 a ton of 或 tons of，後面接可數或不可數名詞，不是在量重量。

example.en: There is a ton of work waiting on my desk.
example.zh: 我桌上有一大堆工作在等著。

extra_vocab.en: a person who works at a bank and helps customers with their money
extra_vocab.note: teller 指銀行櫃檯人員，負責存款、提款與轉帳。多益常見於銀行場景的對話、求才廣告，以及 ATM（automated teller machine）的全名。

example.en: Two tellers were helping customers during the lunch rush.
example.zh: 午餐尖峰時段，有兩位櫃員在服務客人。

example.en: She worked as a bank teller for five years.
example.zh: 她擔任銀行櫃員五年了。

example.en: Please wait in line at the teller window.
example.zh: 請在櫃員窗口前排隊等候。

example.en: The automated teller machine is outside the main entrance.
example.zh: 自動櫃員機在大門外面。

examples.en: Please give the teller your ID before making a withdrawal.
examples.zh: 提款前，請先把你的證件交給櫃員。

examples.en: The bank is hiring a full-time teller for its downtown branch.
examples.zh: 這間銀行正在為市中心的分行徵求一位全職櫃員。

examples.en: The teller asked me to fill out a deposit slip.
examples.zh: 櫃員請我填寫一張存款單。

confusable.diff: cashier 是商店的收銀員；teller 是在銀行辦理存提款的人。

example.en: The cashier scanned my items and printed the receipt.
example.zh: 收銀員掃描了我的商品，並列印出收據。

confusable.diff: clerk 是辦公室或商店的一般職員，不限於銀行。

example.en: The hotel clerk gave me a key to my room.
example.zh: 飯店櫃檯人員給了我房間鑰匙。

example.en: The banker explained the interest rate very clearly.
example.zh: 銀行主管把利率解釋得很清楚。

example.en: She made a deposit at the bank this morning.
example.zh: 她今天早上去銀行存了錢。
